sourceTitle: The History of Little Peter, the Ship Boy
description: "The History of Little Peter, the Ship Boy" by William Henry Giles Kingston is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around young Peter Gray, who is faced with tremendous loss and hardship following the death of his mother and the absence of his father, whom he believes is also dead.
